classes.name: masks
classes.reason: In measure(), probe.read_staged() for class_a is called directly in the main loop and its result is used before sleep_seconds(compute_s) runs, so the rank stalls on each read (captured as gated/class_a_stall_ns) rather than overlapping it with compute.

classes.name: tiles
classes.reason: class_b files are read inside the separate _prefetch worker process ahead of need and pushed onto a bounded queue, so the main rank's compute (sleep_seconds(compute_s)) proceeds concurrently with those reads, only occasionally waiting briefly on queue.get() rather than on the read itself.
